beats.say: ChatGPT was originally released to the public on 30 November 2022.
Users can interact with ChatGPT through conversations consisting of text, audio, and image inputs and outputs.
An optional Memory feature allows users to tell ChatGPT to memorize specific information for future chats.
Which helpful feature do you tend to use the most in your daily chats?
